newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton markets dull, thin.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton markets dull, thin.

text.p: Mill demand was short term in dull European raw cotton markets, with the mills testing prices for the scant volume available to cover inventory gaps in the news 2-3 months.

Tight Central Asian supply supported trade sellers' pricing ideas. Other origins including Syrian and West African were also depleted, so few merchants were set to discount prices to generate business.
Demand for new crop was tentative although some interest has been seen for earliest available Greek and Spanish deliveries.
